title: DiscoveryJob
description: Org-scoped discovery configuration (where/how to discover). Mutable, long-lived.

siteId.description: Site in which this job operates.

clusterId.description: Connector cluster to use for reachability, if applicable.

seeds.description: Seed devices/hosts to begin discovery from (IP or hostname).

targetCidrs.description: CIDR ranges to probe during discovery (e.g., 10.0.0.0/24).

schedule.description: Optional discovery trigger mode. Omit for on-prem manual jobs; use manual with triggerScope when a manual cloud job needs scoped execution, recurring with cron for scheduled jobs, and auto for event-triggered jobs.

cron.description: Cron expression, e.g., '0 0/6 * * *'. Required when mode=recurring.

triggerScope.description: Optional discovery trigger scope for site-specific sub-routing. AWS cloud jobs use AWS_CLOUD or AWS_VPN.

status.description: When paused, manual or scheduled runs are blocked.
